thread:
anita (CS): quick kickoff for Halcyon day0 private deploy. open items from preflight: wrapped key + import token, VPC endpoint policies for S3 & Kinesis, cross-account role trust, and proof of delivery for their SIEM within 30m. any objections to triage now?
oscar (SRE): no objections. I looked at their infra plan: they used a single NAT gateway per AZ but route tables look fine. main ops snag is they require fixed egress IPs for Splunk ingestion.
li (Solutions): for KMS import we need the wrapped key and import token. yara, do you have both or are they gated by legal?
yara (Halcyon): wrapped_key.bin is in s3://halcyon-sec/keys/, token will be provided after NDA amendment is countersigned. legal said EOD.
ben (AE): note: customer tied a renewal credit to audit readiness. if we can't show ingestion by EOW, procurement will pause the credit. flagging as risk.
anita (CS): okay mark health = yellow until ingestion validated. propose P0 checklist: 1) import CMK and verify KeyState=Enabled, 2) test assume-role from priv account, 3) deliver Flow Logs to Splunk HEC with >=90% events <30m, 4) confirm egress whitelist.
oscar (SRE): importing steps i'll run when token is active. snippet I'll use (IAM trust): ```json
{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::998877665544:role/redwood-priv"},"Action":"sts:AssumeRole"}]}
```
li (Solutions): for delivery we recommend Kinesis Firehose -> Splunk HEC with small buffer and S3 backup encrypted with the CMK. reduces chance of >30m gap. can post template.
ci-bot: ticket HAL-2234 created and assigned to oscar, li -> https://tickets.internal/HAL-2234 (automated)
yara (Halcyon): NDA countersigned, token uploaded to s3://halcyon-sec/keys/import_token.bin (access: halcyon/sec-team + redwood-priv-role).
oscar (SRE): running kms import now. will paste describe-key after.
oscar (SRE): import completed, KeyState: Enabled. proceeding with assume-role test.
oscar (SRE): assume-role successful: "sts:AssumeRole succeeded for arn:aws:iam::998877665544:role/redwood-priv"
li (Solutions): kicking smoke harness: 400 events -> monitoring latency and percent under 30m.
ci-bot: smoke-run HAL-2234: 400 events sent, median latency 19s, 99% within 30m. telemetry: https://telemetry.redwood/runs/HAL-2234 (automated)
yara (Halcyon): Splunk confirmed events in index halcyon-prod and retention metadata set. they will whitelist the egress IPs after we provide the list.
anita (CS): excellent. updating onboarding tracker: CMK import , IAM assume-role , flow logs ingestion . final action: yara to confirm egress whitelist completion.
ben (AE): i'll mark renewal risk as mitigated once whitelist confirmation is in. great work team. :thumbsup:
